description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Rukarumel by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.
